disposition_reason: A complete disabled source programme predicts hidden face/object labels on a prespecified 33-person sensor-summary panel. It narrows the umbrella modality contract; authentic inventory, exact protected roster, reference competence, physical isolation and all22 qualification gates remain open. Direct-observation and typed-viewer comparisons are not delivered.

scientific_target.question: On the fixed experiment1 MEG panel, can permitted six-magnetometer summaries distinguish face from object on task-irrelevant trials for simultaneously held-out participants and physical image identities, beyond pre-stimulus and experimental-design controls?
scientific_target.known_answer: A trial face/object category, face positive, privately joined from verified stimulus identity. Scores compare predictions with experimental labels, not an author analysis table.
scientific_target.answer_origin: COGITATE experiment1 event metadata: Stim_trigger1–20 face,21–40 object; retained trial/event/epoch lineage must be authenticated before labels are trusted.
scientific_target.case_unit: One eligible single-trial six-sensor observation, projected to an opaque query nonce in one held-person/image-half fold.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Participant; physical images and repeated trials are crossed dependencies. Two image halves, five arms and three seeds do not add participants.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Retrospective sensor-level category prediction on a fixed selected cohort, with relevance strata. The source programme is not the paper’s source-space category-aware pseudotrial analysis and does not establish new-site or general-population transfer.
exclusions: Whole-theory consciousness adjudication or absence of conscious content from failed decoding.
Source localization, causal neural contribution or conditional independence from paired accuracy differences.
Direct or viewer-mediated model understanding inferred from executable programme scores.

inputs: SIGNAL:60 baseline-corrected means from six fixed good magnetometers in tesla, ten20-ms bins over[0.1,0.3)s; baseline[-0.5,-0.3)s.
PRE:same60-dimensional representation over[-0.3,-0.1)s. NUISANCE:eight duration/relevance/orientation indicators; paired combined arms retain the identical trial universe.
Training labels and opaque grouping keys plus declared training-only inner folds. AccessA supplies specification; B additionally supplies audited ordinary author code.
forbidden_inputs: Query category, Stim_trigger, physical source identity, protected roster, reference predictions and evaluation feedback.
True-label query averaging/pseudotrial grouping and target-person or target-image fitting.
Undeclared source lookup, per-case carryover or checkpoint exposure to this public source family.
observation_contract.case_identity: Source lineage joins person/visit/run/raw-sample/original epoch selection; fresh random opaque_query_nonce hides that join. Actual eligible query count and exact33-person roster remain protected/unqualified; job IDs are not observations.
observation_contract.split: 66 outer folds cross one held person with one held image half; train on all other people and opposite physical image half. Eight inner folds cross four training-person groups with two training-image groups. This prospective source split has not been executed.
observation_contract.coverage: All33 selected people and330 person/run dispositions require census; five arms × four access/mode settings × three seeds ×66folds gives3960 candidate jobs, plus1650 fixed-reference jobs and12 interpretation reports. These are nested conditions of one registration, not3960 benchmarks; query counts remain unverified.

primary.name: B/F/SIGNAL participant-macro balanced accuracy on task-irrelevant trials
primary.aggregation: Within each participant, equal face/object recall in each duration×orientation cell; equal-weight nine cells, then33participants. Report three seeds without treating them as biological replication.
primary.rationale: Matches actual metrics.py and isolates hidden category prediction from class imbalance, duration/orientation imbalance and source-reconstruction accuracy.

secondary: Balanced log loss and balanced Brier; legacy unbalanced log loss separately labeled.
Paired SIGNAL−PRE, SIGNAL−NUISANCE, SIGNAL_NUISANCE−NUISANCE and SIGNAL_NUISANCE−PRE_NUISANCE; all relevance strata and access/mode arms retained.
Independent structured interpretation reports are separate from prediction score; no combined reasoning scalar.

comparators.name: R0 constant probability
comparators.procedure: Implemented source returns p_face=0.5 on the identical query universe; never infer chance from an imbalanced ordinary accuracy.

comparators.name: R1 fixed and R2 selected logistic regression
comparators.inputs: The identical feature arm and training-only labeled data.
comparators.procedure: R1 fixed C=1; R2 chooses C from0.0001,0.01,0.1,1,10,100 using all eight crossed inner folds. Training-only scaling, participant/class weights, convergence refusal; R2 is the named primary reference.

comparators.name: R3 shrinkage discriminant and R4 histogram boosting
comparators.procedure: Implemented source freezes finite grids and independent numeric-state prediction; native numerical equivalence and competence remain unqualified.

nuisance_controls: Equal duration/orientation support and fixed task-relevance strata; recorded response/target trials excluded without using neural outcomes.
Same retained observation universe for signal, pre-stimulus, nuisance and combined arms.
Physical-image alias separation, source preprocessing/filter lineage, site/system mapping and prior exposure audit.
No positive difference is labeled conditional mutual information or proof that all motor confounding is removed.
evaluation.uncertainty: Use paired participant differences while retaining shared-image and overlapping-training dependencies; seeds summarize algorithm variation. Calibration of a population-level interval requires separate qualification; no numeric confidence or human baseline is invented.
evaluation.failure_policy: Exact query identity sets, all five arms and finite nonboolean probabilities in[0,1] required. A missing class cell makes full-panel metrics null rather than dropping participants; retain failed fits and resource failures.

implementation.scorer_target: Genuine privately labeled single-trial face/object probability accuracy/loss; separate interpretation rubric. It does not grade similarity to the paper’s reported decoding table.
